title: Meerkats Audit Log v1 — append-only, hash-chained
description: The system-of-record for consequential events: every mutation, every approval decision, every standing-config change. Distinct from task-trace (observability): audit is complete (never sampled), immutable, tamper-evident, and attributable. Because mutation is confined to the action and workflow intents, auditing those two paths captures every state change. Events form a per-tenant hash chain (prev_hash → hash); stored append-only in the system-of-record with UPDATE/DELETE revoked at the DB role. Events reference immutable artifacts (resolved_selection, execution_plan, task) by digest rather than embedding them.

seq.description: monotonic per tenant; gaps signal missing/dropped events

prev_hash.description: hash of the previous event in this tenant's chain; null only for the genesis event

hash.description: digest over this event's canonical serialization EXCLUDING hash and signature; links the chain

signature.description: optional detached cryptographic signature over hash, for non-repudiation

trace_id.description: correlates to the task-trace for the same request

risk_level.description: echoed from the execution_plan for fast filtering

task_ref.description: the task instance that was submitted

resolved_selection_ref.description: the frozen selection acted on — proves WHICH entities changed

allOf.description: execution events must cite the resolved selection they acted on
approval outcomes must carry the decision

actor.description: Who caused the event. For autonomous runs, kind=workflow and on_behalf_of names the human who authorized it — that pairing is what makes an unattended action non-repudiable.

principal_ref.description: server-side principal id; never raw PII

on_behalf_of.description: for workflow/system actors, the human principal who created/approved the standing config

trigger.description: for workflow/system actors, what fired it (schedule id or event)

entity_ids.description: for mutations, the frozen member_ids acted on

config_ref.description: for config_* actions, the standing object's id

change_set.description: per-entity before/after — the actual delta a mutation produced

policy.description: which approval rule required this (e.g. risk=high)
